## 8 The state read of element 11's processing resource: the one payload every command of the resource answers, served for whoever opens the order.

Both the employee and the resolver scope reach it (element 11's auth matrix): a resolver deciding a resume has to see what is held, and the payload carries no customer-facing field the customer scope could not see — that scope has its own resource (element 18, D-11-4).

Method and path
: `GET` `/processing/{processingId}`

Authentication
: `bearer JWT`

<!-- evidence: services/fulfillment/src/main/java/shop/fulfillment/AppConfiguration.java:118 -->

Consumes
: no request body

Produces
: `application/json`, `application/json`
